title: Study Suggests Link Between Long Sleep Times, Cognitive Loss
summary: Хэт бага эсвэл хэт их унтах нь ахмад хүмүүсийн бодох чадварт муу нөлөөлж болох тухай.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Hai Do wrote this story for Learning English. Caty Weaver was the editor.

changes: Heading, sign-off, credit line, quiz link and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What did the Washington University study find?
options: Both too little and too much sleep were linked to worse thinking
Only people who slept too little had lower scores
Sleeping more always helped older people think better
questions.explain: "Short and long sleep times were associated with worse cognitive performance" гэж судалгааг удирдсан Люси хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: How old were the people in the study, on average?
questions.explain: "The average age of the study subject was 75" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What does "sweet spot" mean in this text?
options: The best middle range of sleep time
A kind of sugar that helps sleep
questions.explain: Люси "there is a middle range, or 'sweet spot,' for total sleep time" гэсэн. Энд хамгийн тохиромжтой дунд хэмжээг хэлж байна.
